Tipp

Try out cross-country skiing in Füssen

There is no need to buy expensive cross-country skiing equipment, as this is also available to hire. And if you want to learn cross-country skiing or switch from classic style to skating, the cross-country skiing courses are the right place for you. Our partner Allgäu Aktiv also offers individual cross-country skiing courses throughout the winter season.
